text:
FIFA Wiadi Kɔp a ɛdi kan no wɔ Uruguay fi 13 kɔsi 30 July 1930, na wɔyɛɛ no titiriw wɔ Estadio Centenario a wɔtɔɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbɔɔ no maa tournament no wɔ Montevideo. Kuw 13 pɛ na ɛtɔɔ mu: ɛpo a ɛware a wɔfa kɔ South America no brɛɛ aman Europe pii, na European kuw anan pɛ na wɔyɛɛ no. Nni qualifying rounds. Wɔde kuw 13 a wɔfrɛɛ no nyinaa too four round-robin groups mu, na group winner biara kɔɔ single-elimination semi-finals mu, a ɛdi akyiri no final. Nni third-place play-off biara.

Tournament no buee abakɔsɛm foforɔ. Lucien Laurent a ɔfiri France no bɔɔ goal a ɛdi kan wɔ Wiadi Kɔp abakɔsɛm mu, na Bert Patenaude a ɔfiri United States no na FIFA ka sɛ ɔno na ɔyɛ competition no hat-trick a ɛdi kan. Knockout rounds no yɛɛ symmetry a ɛyɛ nwonwa: semifinal a ɛba no nyinaa wiee 6-1, Argentina di United States so, na Uruguay nso di Yugoslavia so sɛ 6-1. United States a wɔdi nkogu wɔ semifinal no mu no, FIFA de no too mũ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, nanso wɔannyɛ match biara de kyerɛ no.

Ɛno na ɛde final a ɛda host nation no ne ne nea ɔbɛn no Argentina ntam wɔ Estadio Centenario wɔ Montevideo, ɛyɛ Wiadi Kɔp final a ɛdi kan a ɛda South American aman mmienu ne Spanish kasa aman mmienu ntam. Nnɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa bi wɔ mu: Belgian official John Langenus na ɔreferee, na wɔka sɛ wɔbɔɔ no ball foforɔ wɔ half biara mu ɛfiri sɛ kuw mmienu no antumi annya ball baako. Argentina dii 2-1 wɔ half-time, nanso Uruguay de goals mmiɛnsa a wɔammɔ mu wɔ second-half no mu a Cea, Iriarte ne Castro bɔɔ no dii 4-2, na wɔanhia extra time. Wɔka sɛ nnipa bɛyɛ 68,000 na wɔbaa hɔ, nanso nsɛm foforɔ kyerɛ sɛ ɛsono.

Ɛno nti Uruguay bɛyɛɛ champions, wɔde Wiadi Kɔp title a ɛdi kan no, na wɔyɛɛ host nation a ɛdi kan a ɛdi nkunim wɔ tournament no mu, Argentina nso yɛ runner-up. Argentina Guillermo Stabile na ɔdi competition no top scorer a ɔwɔ goals 8. Nni official best-player award wɔ 1930 mu, enti ɛnyɛ nea wɔakyerɛw.
